method: Node22.23.4/CPU2/8GiB actual paths; one wall sample per scenario, no wall p95. Inclusive phase quantiles only first up to20000 observations. Before legacy is a separate process; after legacy follows two scenarios. GC callbacks may include setup collections delivered at later yields, not exact replay GC. Memory is sampled process RSS/heap, not peak/Worker heap. CPU samples cover whole tool incl Vite/encoding/instrumentation; not a device SLA or precise cross-run ratio.
